oauth.title: Connect {{client}} to Quberi
oauth.intro: {{client}} is asking to search the knowledge you can read in Quberi.
oauth.can: Search passages from the spaces you can read, in the organization you choose below.
oauth.cannot: It can't upload, edit or delete anything, and can't see spaces you don't have access to.
oauth.canRead: Search passages from the spaces you can read, in the organization you choose below.
oauth.canSave: Save notes into a space you can edit (your personal space unless it names another).
oauth.canUpload: Upload files (images, PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text) into a space you can edit (your personal space unless it names another).
oauth.cannotWriteOrUpload: It can't change or delete what's already there, and can't see spaces you don't have access to. Anything it saves or uploads becomes a document that others with access to that space can find.
oauth.canWrite: Search passages from the spaces you can read, and save notes into a space you can edit (your personal space unless it names another).
oauth.cannotWrite: It can't change or delete what's already there, and can't see spaces you don't have access to. Notes it saves become documents others with access to that space can find.
oauth.leaves: What it finds is sent to {{client}} and its AI model, without Quberi's “check before sending” step. Every search and every saved note is recorded in your organization's audit log.
oauth.offAskAdmin: Outside tools are off here. Ask an owner or admin to turn them on.

deactivateDialog.keeps: What they uploaded to shared spaces stays and can still be found by people with access.
deactivateDialog.needsTransfer: {{count}} collaboration spaces they own need a new owner. Hand them over from the offboarding checklist after deactivating.
deactivateDialog.orgChatFallback: The organisation's chat model uses this person's private key. After deactivating, chat switches to the platform default model and counts against the platform's free allowance.
deactivateDialog.embeddingBlocked: The organisation's embedding model uses this person's private key. Choose an organisation or platform model in the AI settings first, then deactivate.
deactivateDialog.restoreNote: Reactivating only restores the account and the personal space. Deleted or revoked credentials and paused syncs are not restored; the person signs in again and reconnects what they need.
